_about: Every outside host shipped Aman code may name, with why. scripts/check-external-hosts.mjs (pnpm run test:external-hosts) fails on any host not listed here, on a link-only host that is loaded, and on any forbidden host. Names on this machine or the private network (localhost, Docker service names, reserved test names, private addresses) are not outside hosts and are never listed.
